_meta.description: Enterprise API Contracts for Micro-Site Builder

GET /api/v1/sites/{slug}.description: Yayinlanmis mikro siteyi render eder. CDN katmanindan servis edilir. / Render a published micro-site. Served from CDN edge.

statusCodes.404: Site not found or not published

200.description: Full site render data including pages, theme, and media

schema.title: string
schema.siteType: string (bio | event | product | business_card | link_in_bio | coming_soon | resume | podcast | custom)

theme.colors: object { primary, secondary, background, text, accent }

POST /api/v1/sites/{id}/contact.description: Iletisim formu gonderimi. Spam korumali. / Submit a contact form. Spam-protected (reCAPTCHA / honeypot).

message.example: Hi, I'd like to discuss a project opportunity.

honeypot.description: Honeypot field — must be empty for valid submission

statusCodes.400: Invalid request body / missing required fields
statusCodes.422: Validation error (message too short, invalid email)
statusCodes.429: Too many submissions from this IP

GET /api/v1/sites/{slug}/qr.description: Site URL'si icin QR kod gorseli dondurur. / Returns a QR code image for the site URL.

size.description: QR kod boyutu (px) / QR code size in pixels

POST /api/v1/sites.description: Sablon kullanarak yeni mikro site olusturur. / Create a new micro-site from a template.

slug.description: Unique subdomain tanimlayici / Unique subdomain identifier

password.description: Site sifresi (isPasswordProtected = true ise zorunlu) / Site password

noIndex.description: Arama motorlarina dizinlenmesin mi / Disallow search engine indexing

201.description: Yeni olusturulan site / Newly created site

GET /api/v1/sites.description: Kullanicinin mikro sitelerini listeler. / List the authenticated user's micro-sites.

limit.description: Sayfa basina kayit / Items per page

status.description: Duruma gore filtrele / Filter by status

siteType.description: Site tipine gore filtrele / Filter by site type

search.description: Baslik veya slug'da ara / Search in title or slug

GET /api/v1/sites/{id}.description: Site icerigini ve ayarlarini getirir. Sahip veya collaborator erisimi. / Get full site content and settings. Owner or collaborator access.

200.description: Complete site data with pages, collaborators, and media

PUT /api/v1/sites/{id}.description: Site icerigini ve ayarlarini gunceller. / Update site content and settings (title, slug, pages, password, noIndex).

slug.description: Unique subdomain tanimlayici / Unique subdomain identifier

noIndex.description: Arama motoru dizinlemesi / Search engine indexing

pages.description: Sayfa listesi (full replace) / Pages array (full replace)

id.description: Existing page ID (omit for new pages)

statusCodes.403: Forbidden — not owner or editor collaborator

DELETE /api/v1/sites/{id}.description: Mikro siteyi siler. Iliskili sayfalar, medya ve yedekler de silinir. / Delete a micro-site. Cascades to pages, media, and backups.

example.message: Site and all associated data deleted successfully

POST /api/v1/sites/{id}/publish.description: Siteyi CDN'de yayinlar. / Publish site to CDN. Moves status from draft to published.

invalidateCache.description: CDN on bellegini temizle / Invalidate CDN cache

statusCodes.403: Forbidden — not owner or editor collaborator
statusCodes.422: Site has no pages / validation error

POST /api/v1/sites/{id}/duplicate.description: Siteyi kopyalar. Yeni slug otomatik olusturulur. / Duplicate a site. A new slug is auto-generated (original-slug-copy-N).

title.description: Yeni site basligi (belirtilmezse Copy of {title}) / New site title

slug.description: Yeni slug (belirtilmezse otomatik) / New slug (auto if omitted)

statusCodes.403: Forbidden — not owner or editor collaborator

PUT /api/v1/sites/{id}/theme.description: Temayi gunceller (renkler, fontlar, layout). / Update theme settings (colors, fonts, layout).

statusCodes.400: Invalid color format or layout value
statusCodes.403: Forbidden — not owner or editor collaborator

theme.colors: object { primary, secondary, background, text, accent }

POST /api/v1/sites/{id}/media.description: Siteye medya dosyasi yukler. / Upload a media file to the site.

file.constraints: Max 50 MB. Allowed MIME types: image/*, video/mp4, video/webm, application/pdf

fileName.description: Ozel dosya adi (belirtilmezse orijinal ad kullanilir) / Custom file name

statusCodes.400: Invalid file type or size exceeds limit
statusCodes.403: Forbidden — not owner or editor collaborator

DELETE /api/v1/sites/{id}/media/{mediaId.description: Medya dosyasini siler (storage'dan da kaldirilir). / Delete a media file (also removed from storage).

statusCodes.403: Forbidden — not owner or editor collaborator

GET /api/v1/sites/{id}/analytics.description: Site analitik verilerini getirir. / Get site analytics data (views, visitors, referrers, devices).

from.description: Baslangic tarihi / Start date (default: 30 days ago)

statusCodes.403: Forbidden — not owner or editor collaborator

200.description: Site analytics with time-series and aggregate data

POST /api/v1/sites/{id}/export.description: Siteyi statik HTML/ZIP olarak disa aktarir. / Export site as a static HTML/ZIP archive.

includeMedia.description: Medya dosyalari dahil edilsin mi / Include media files

minifyAssets.description: CSS/JS minimize edilsin mi / Minify CSS and JS

statusCodes.202: Export processing — check back with download URL

200.description: Download URL for the exported archive

GET /api/v1/templates.description: Kullanilabilir sablonlari listeler. / List available templates, filtered by site type.
GET /api/v1/templates.auth: optional (bearer optional; public templates are always visible)

limit.description: Sayfa basina kayit / Items per page

siteType.description: Site tipine gore filtrele / Filter by site type

data.name: Minimal Bio
data.description: Clean and minimal personal bio page with hero, about, and contact sections.

GET /api/v1/templates/{id}.description: Sablon onizleme verisini, varsayilan temayi ve bolum sablonlarini getirir. / Get template preview data including default theme and section presets.
GET /api/v1/templates/{id}.auth: optional (bearer optional; public templates are always visible)

200.description: Full template data with theme defaults and section presets

schema.name: string

themeDefaults.colors: object { primary, secondary, background, text, accent }

schema.sectionPresets: array (ordered list of default section configurations)

example.name: Minimal Bio
example.description: Clean and minimal personal bio page with hero, about, and contact sections.

POST /api/v1/admin/domains.description: Site icin ozel alan adi ekler. SSL sertifikasi otomatik baslatilir. / Add a custom domain for a site. SSL provisioning starts automatically.

statusCodes.201: Domain added successfully — SSL provisioning started
statusCodes.409: Domain already assigned to another site

GET /api/v1/admin/domains.description: Tum ozel alan adlarini SSL durumlariyla listeler. / List all custom domains with SSL status.

limit.description: Sayfa basina kayit / Items per page

sslStatus.description: SSL durumuna gore filtrele / Filter by SSL status

dnsVerified.description: DNS dogrulama durumuna gore filtrele / Filter by DNS verification status

search.description: Alan adinda ara / Search in domain name

DELETE /api/v1/admin/domains/{id}.description: Ozel alan adini kaldirir ve SSL sertifikasini iptal eder. / Remove a custom domain and revoke its SSL certificate.

example.message: Custom domain removed and SSL certificate revoked

GET /api/v1/admin/sites.description: Tum siteleri admin genel gorunumuyle listeler. / List all sites for admin overview — includes owner info and aggregated stats.

limit.description: Sayfa basina kayit / Items per page

status.description: Duruma gore filtrele / Filter by status

siteType.description: Site tipine gore filtrele / Filter by site type

ownerEmail.description: Sahip e-postasina gore filtrele / Filter by owner email

search.description: Baslik, slug veya alan adinda ara / Search in title, slug, or domain

200.description: Paginated list of all sites with owner and stats

GET /api/v1/admin/analytics.description: Platform genel kullanim metriklerini getirir. / Get platform-wide usage metrics (total sites, users, views, etc.).

from.description: Baslangic tarihi / Start date (default: 30 days ago)
